signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 1 US office
3 new PM roles posted this week

bullets: Contribute to active product work: Support the team on real platform work, such as researching a problem, shaping requirements, or evaluating options, with guidance from your…
Understand the people we build for: Join conversations with editors and other stakeholders to learn how they work, where the friction is, and what a better workflow looks like.
Help organize and prioritize opportunities: Collect and structure ideas and requests so the team can prioritize them using established frameworks.
Use data and research to inform decisions: Combine qualitative feedback with existing data to help frame problems and suggest how to test ideas.
Communicate clearly: Write concise updates, briefs, and other messages, adapting them for a range of audiences, from engineering colleagues to cross-functional partners.

roles.title: Technical Product Manager II, Content Data Products

bullets: Roadmap Execution: Lead the strategy and delivery for the content data warehouse and ingestion pipelines for new content types and metadata enrichment.
Data Modeling & Indexing: Define specifications for modeling, ingesting, and indexing new content formats (e.g., video, interactives, acquired brand content) for search…
Catalog Optimization: Partner with operations, legal, and teams to audit archival structures, address metadata gaps, and improve catalog completeness.
Collaboration: Gather requirements, establish data contracts, prioritize features, and communicate roadmap progress and risks across engineering, design, editorial, and leadership.
Product Delivery: Guide the end-to-end product development lifecycle from concept to launch with high quality.

roles.title: Technical Product Manager II, Data Platforms

bullets: Own the strategy for shared compute and storage capabilities, including compute engines, streaming, orchestration, lakehouse storage, and connective infrastructure.
Understand platform users’ workflows and translate their needs into clear outcomes, requirements, and priorities.
Partner with engineering leaders to scope initiatives, define milestones, manage dependencies and delivery risks, and keep execution aligned with product priorities.
Deliver self-service capabilities that help teams build, publish, and operate data products without managing underlying infrastructure; favor reusable solutions.
Communicate roadmap progress, risks, and tradeoffs to stakeholders.
